A first panel-data exercise. Belongs to [Panel regression](../topics/50-panel-regression.qmd).

```{=html}
<p><a class="mp-download" href="/ae/ae08-panel-regression-part-1.zip" download>⬇ Download ae08-panel-regression-part-1.zip</a></p>
```

:::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Unzip it, then open the `.Rproj` file in RStudio. Every path inside the exercises is relative to that project, so the data will load without edits.
::::

:::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Uses panel datasets from the `plm` and `pder` packages — no `data/` folder.
::::
